get.description:
Readiness probe with real dependency checks.

Reports 503 with per-dependency status when any dependency is
unreachable; 200 only when the database and Ollama are both reachable.
Setting ``OLLAMA_BASE_URL=""`` disables the Ollama check for hosts
without a local model server (e.g. cloud staging).

Issue an email OTP (creating a pending user if the email is unknown).

Privacy-aware: the response is identical whether or not the address was

Verify the email OTP, activate the user, and open a web session.

get.description:
Start the OAuth flow: build the provider authorize URL.

The state/nonce pair is stored server-side (single-use, 10-min TTL) and
the state is returned so the web client passes it back on the callback.

Finish the OAuth flow: verify state+id_token, then login/link/signup.

Account-linking protection: a provider-verified email belonging to an
ACTIVE account returns 409 OAUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN (never silently merged); a
PENDING email-OTP user is claimed (activated + linked).

post.description:
Ingest a liveness selfie for manual review (E3 wave 1).

Validation order: pending status → consent → challenge consume (atomic,
single-use) → magic bytes → size → dimensions → metadata-stripping
re-encode → 0700/0600 storage. The response never contains a storage
path, filename, or URL.

are auto-rejected and their raw files deleted before listing.

EmailOtpRequest.title: EmailOtpRequest
EmailOtpRequest.description:
Passwordless signup: request an OTP code (E1). Response is
privacy-aware — identical whether or not the email is known.

EmailOtpSentResponse.title: EmailOtpSentResponse
EmailOtpSentResponse.description:
Privacy-aware response — identical whether or not the email exists.

``delivery_mode`` tells the client HOW the code was delivered so the UI
can be honest: ``dev`` means no real email is sent in this environment
(the code is in the server outbox / log); ``provider`` means real email.
